items.html: And it was already explained above that these seven kings took their illuminations from the looking of the light of the eyes of AK at the lights of Akudim, in the phase of their expansion downward in the place of the body of AK, and therefore they broke, since they lacked the illumination of GAR in them, which are AHP in their place above, and therefore both face and posterior broke. Therefore three crowns were affixed to each of their letters, to indicate the deficiency and absence of the three kinds of lights mentioned, from the vessels, which are the letters, and the light remained above the bodies, which are the letters, and not within them, as the secret of the crowns will be explained further below.
